explication: RSTGameTranslation is a Windows desktop app that captures game or manga text, recognizes it, translates it, and presents the result as an overlay or chat history. The documented workflow is to select a game window or screen region, enable the overlay, and start translation; copied text and game audio are additional input paths. README capabilities include manga speech-bubble handling, multiple cloud and local translators, and speech output. Source-index references support several internal calls; other workflow links are documented by the README, so unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
